A stone is dropped from rest at a height of 2.0m above the surface of a planet.
The planet has no atmosphere.
The speed of the stone just before reaching the surface of the planet is 3.8m/s.
What is the acceleration of free fall on the planet?
1.9m/s2
3.6m/s2
7.2m/s2
